texts.preamble: In Re:- Manik Rui Das vs Re: An Application For Bail Under ... on 23 November, 2016 Author: Ashim Kumar Roy
texts.arguments: It is submitted by the learned Counsel for the petitioner that his client has approached this Court for bail for the first time and now he is in custody for 1 year 55 days. He further submits that the only allegation against his client is that from his possession 6 liters of spurious I.D.liquor was recovered and by consuming the same, one person died. Then he submits that one of the co-accused was granted bail from whose possession, 5 litres of such I.D.liquor was recovered. On the other hand, the learned Public Prosecutor opposes the prayer for bail and submits that this is case, where by consuming the spurious I.D.liquor, total 23 persons died and according to the materials collected during investigation, it appears that the petitioner is not only the seller but he is the kingpin, who sold those spurious I.D.liquor to other accused and from whose shop after purchasing and by consuming such I.D.liquor, they died.
